title: Remove One Element to Make the Array Strictly Increasing
goal: Decide whether deleting exactly one element can leave a strictly increasing array.
strategy: At the first non-increasing pair, remove the larger predecessor if the earlier prefix permits it; otherwise remove the current value. A second conflict exhausts the deletion budget.
